name: Cucumber & fennel salad
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical salad recipe scaling with ~1kg total ingredients for 4 side servings
Prep time estimated as 15 minutes based on 10 min salting wait plus quick mixing steps; no cooking involved
Sour cream classified as dairy (Milk allergen present) and non-vegan
All other ingredients compatible with listed diets and absent of other allergens
No gluten sources (e.g. no barley/rye/wheat/oats) detected
Sugar, vinegar, and lemon juice treated as pure and allergen-free
instructions:
step 1
Put cucumber in a sieve. Sprinkle with 1 tsp salt and the sugar, then leave for 10 mins. Add fennel.

step 2
Mix soured cream, lemon juice, vinegar and dill, then season with black pepper and add to fennel mix.

ingredients.name: Cucumber
ingredients.assumptions: 1 large cucumber ≈ 400g edible portion, raw, unpeeled

ingredients.name: Fennel Bulb
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium fennel bulb, trimmed and sliced ≈ 250g edible portion, raw

ingredients.name: Lemon
ingredients.assumptions: Juice of 1 medium lemon ≈ 30g, typical yield

ingredients.name: Dill
ingredients.assumptions: 1 bunch fresh dill ≈ 25g edible leaves and stems
